faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear, direct answers about working with Epic Optimize.

items.q: How does a new project start?
items.a: It begins with a free initial discovery discussion via email or WhatsApp. We review your requirements, target audience, and current digital state. Within 48 hours, we provide a clear proposal with scope, milestone breakdown, and transparent pricing.

items.q: How do you handle working across different time zones?
items.a: Our studio is based in Dhaka (GMT+6 / BST), which naturally overlaps with Asia-Pacific morning hours, European & Gulf mid-days, and North American morning/evening handoffs. We rely on clear asynchronous documentation, sprint boards, and scheduled video syncs when required.

items.q: What do you need from our team before starting?
items.a: Basic brand assets (logo, colors if available), a brief description of your offer or products, access to any existing hosting or domain accounts, and a designated project lead on your side for milestone sign-offs.

items.q: Can you improve or redesign our existing website?
items.a: Yes. We frequently conduct deep audits of existing websites to diagnose slow loading speeds, poor conversion funnels, outdated code, or broken SEO architecture, and then systematically rebuild or optimize them.
